title: The Keeper of Even Odds
text:
A brass automaton kneels in the dust, one [amber]lantern[/amber] lit in its left hand, one dark in its right. A plaque at its knees reads, in the old script: [fade]ONE WILL WARM YOU. ONE WILL REMEMBER YOU.[/fade]

It waits for you to choose a hand.

outcome.text: The flame gutters, then steadies in a careful grip. Warmth, and with it a stranger's lullaby, known now by heart.
The lantern goes dark the moment it leaves the brass hand. Still, in the smoke, there is a child's face. It is kept.

choices.label: Snatch the dark one
choices.outcome: The automaton's fingers close on nothing. Inside the dark lantern, something remembers being a candle.

choices.label: Break both hands
choices.outcome: Brass shrieks. Both lanterns spill: one fire, one memory. The automaton watches you with no expression at all.

choices.label: Wind the key
choices.outcome: Gears turn for the first time in a thousand years. It bows, sets both lanterns down, and walks into the dark to finish an errand nobody remembers.
